mechanism_narrative: A rise in GDP above its 6-month moving average indicates a strengthening economy, leading to increased consumer spending and positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are not significantly higher than baseline during periods of GDP growth above its 6-month moving average (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A drop in the federal funds rate below 0.5% signals an accommodative monetary policy, leading to increased borrowing and positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: Walk-forward Rank IC remains below 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window, or 60-day forward returns in easing periods are not significantly higher than baseline (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A decline in the unemployment rate below 5% indicates a tightening labor market, leading to increased wage pressure and negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: 5-day forward returns are not significantly lower than baseline during periods of low unemployment (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: An increase in industrial production above its 3-month moving average indicates a strengthening supply chain, leading to increased efficiency and positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are not significantly higher than baseline during periods of industrial production growth above its 3-month moving average (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A rise in housing starts above 1.2 million units indicates a strengthening housing market, leading to increased consumer spending and positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: 60-day forward returns are not significantly higher than baseline during periods of high housing starts (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: An increase in the federal funds rate above 2% and a decrease in GDP below its 6-month moving average indicates a tightening monetary policy and a slowing economy, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are not significantly lower than baseline during periods of high interest rates and low GDP growth (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A rise in payroll employment above 200,000 jobs and a decrease in the unemployment rate below 5% indicates a strengthening labor market, leading to increased wage pressure and negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: 5-day forward returns are not significantly lower than baseline during periods of high employment growth and low unemployment (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A rise in retail sales above 5% year-over-year and a decrease in the federal funds rate below 1% indicates a strengthening consumer sector and an accommodative monetary policy, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: 60-day forward returns are not significantly higher than baseline during periods of high retail sales growth and low interest rates (t-test p > 0.05).
